B1-02.ko: 화약 자루 내던져 퍽 · 맨몸으로 맞고 휘청
B1-02.atk: hurls its oversized powder sack into the foe: a coarse canvas whoosh, a heavy dusty thump that bursts through, then a gritty hiss of spilling black powder
B1-02.def: no armour, it staggers under the blow: a soft cloth-and-flesh thud, creaking sack straps, loose powder grains pattering onto stone

B1-03.ko: 연기 속 달려가 작은 권총 탕 · 움찔 물러남
B1-03.atk: a quick scuffing sprint through hissing smoke, a tiny flintlock pistol pops with a sharp spark-snap, then a light thin ping of the ball striking
B1-03.def: no cover, it flinches and ducks: a startled cloth rustle, one light scuff of boots, a faint cough of smoke puffing past

B1-04.ko: 꽂을대 급히 밀어 넣고 발사 · 비틀거림
B1-04.atk: a hurried ramrod scrape down a barrel, a clumsy clatter of dropped cartridges, then a sharp small musket crack and a thin whistle of the ball
B1-04.def: a clumsy stumble: a soft thump against its chest, rattling cartridge pouches, a brass casing tinkling away across the ground

B1-05.ko: 어설프게 화승총 쏨 · 총으로 얼굴 가림
B1-05.atk: a nervous fumbled cock of the match-lock, a fizzing spark of the pan, a delayed ragged musket bang with a wobbly low echo
B1-05.def: it hugs the musket up as a shield: a dull wooden knock on the stock, a metallic scrape of the barrel, a startled boot shuffle

B1-08.ko: 연막통 던지면 쉬익 퍼짐 · 연기에 숨어 비켜섬
B1-08.atk: an arm swish, a clay canister clunks and cracks open, a long soft whoosh of billowing smoke with a rasping hiss spreading wide
B1-08.def: it ducks behind its own haze: a muffled cloth swish, a dull miss thud on dirt, soft airy puffs of smoke swallowing the impact

B1-09.ko: 표준 화승총 한 방 · 몸으로 받아 주춤
B1-09.atk: a flint snap and spark, a crisp flintlock boom with a puff of expelled air, then a swift whistle ending in a flat smack of lead
B1-09.def: no armour, it takes the hit on its leather jerkin: a muted slap, a stumble of boots, a tin powder flask jangling on its belt

B1-10.ko: 창 끝으로 쿡 밀어냄 · 철모와 문 방패로 막음
B1-10.atk: a short heavy spear thrust: a leather creak, a stiff iron-tipped jab and a dull clank as the point meets armour with a grating scrape
B1-10.def: a dented iron helm and gate shield take the blow: a clanging knock, a shallow ring-out of old metal, hinges creaking under the push

B1-12.ko: 폭약 묻고 터뜨림 · 흙과 몸으로 버팀
B1-12.atk: a trowel scraping and burying a charge, a quick fizz of a short fuse, then a deep earthy crump that kicks up gravel and falling dirt
B1-12.def: a thick leather apron absorbs the hit: a heavy muffled thump, a clay-and-gravel patter, a ringing high tone fading from half-deaf ears

B1-13.atk: a clay jar swung overhead with a creaking arm, a whoosh through air, a crash of shattering pottery, then a rolling roar of spreading flames
B1-13.def: a quick hop back, a jar-shaped satchel thudding against its hip, scorched leather sizzling and a thin pop of a spilled oil spark

B1-14.ko: 녹슨 총열 한 발 · 바위틈에서 납작 엎드림
B1-14.atk: a dry slow bolt of breath, a long rusty barrel cracks with a single sharp report, a thin whine of a distant bullet and a faraway ping on stone
B1-14.def: it presses flat in a rock crevice: a low scrape of stone on leather, a pebble clatter, a small tight thud of the ball chipping the rock above

B1-16.ko: 도화선 불붙여 던지자 터짐 · 몸으로 버티며 펑
B1-16.atk: a match scratch and quick spitting fizz, a bundled stick of powder tossed with a whoosh, then a sharp booming blast that punches straight through
B1-16.def: no armour, a hasty crouch: a soft thud into charred cloth, a rattle of spare fuse spools, sparks sputtering out against the ground

B1-17.ko: 거대한 포구가 쾅 · 묵직한 포신 뒤에서 버팀
B1-17.atk: a heavy rumbling cart wheel halting, a deep drum-like wide-bore cannon boom that shakes the ground, then a rolling echo bouncing off the hills
B1-17.def: it hides behind the thick iron barrel: a heavy clang of metal, a deep dull thud, then a long low ring-out as the barrel settles

B1-18.ko: 화약통 방패로 총 쏨 · 통을 쾅 두드려 막음
B1-18.atk: a clipped sentry volley: boots snapping to a stop, a tight line of musket cracks together, then a dry rattle of cartridge boxes closing
B1-18.def: they brace behind iron-hooped powder barrels: a deep hollow knock of oak, a firm clank of hoops, only a restrained dusty rustle of black powder inside

B1-20.ko: 파편탄 던짐 · 철판 방패에 파편이 튕김
B1-20.atk: a satchel of bombs tossed with a swish, a bright burst-pop mid-air, then a spraying rattle of iron shards pinging in all directions
B1-20.def: a rounded iron shield catches a glancing knock: a bright metallic clunk, several tiny shards ticking off the plate, boots scraping to hold

B1-21.ko: 바퀴 굴러 멈추고 쾅 · 나무 포가가 삐걱
B1-21.atk: wooden wheels rumbling down a slope, a squealing axle brake, a lurching stop, then a flat heavy cannon blast with a rolling trundle back
B1-21.def: a thick oak carriage takes the strike: a hollow knock, creaking spokes and axle groaning, a loose cannonball rolling away with a low rumble

B1-22.ko: 불 뿜는 통 쉬익 · 통 안 연료가 출렁
B1-22.atk: a pressurised tank valve cracks open, a hot pulsing whoosh of a long gush of fire, with crackling spit and flickering roar throughout
B1-22.def: a squat iron fuel tank on its back is struck: a dull sloshing clang, a rattle of hose clamps, nervous low hiss of leaking pressure

B1-24.ko: 포탄 포신에 풍덩, 하늘로 휙 · 쾅 소리 받아 낮게 웅크림
B1-24.atk: a shell dropped down a tube with a metallic clunk, a hollow thoomp lobbing it skyward, a long falling whistle, ending in a distant crumping burst
B1-24.def: it ducks into its helmet-like iron pot: a dented tinny clang, a hollow ring, sand and loose pebbles trickling down the sides

B1-25.ko: 육중한 대포 여럿이 차례로 포 · 흙 보루 뒤에서 흔들림
B1-25.atk: several heavy guns thunder in staggered order: a deep rolling boom, a second, a third, each with chains clanking and wood recoiling
B1-25.def: thick earthworks and gabions absorb the fire: a deep packed-earth thump, wicker creaking, a long cascade of soil sliding, a muffled ground tremor

B1-26.ko: 내리막 질주하며 쾅 · 쇠 방패판 찌그러짐
B1-26.atk: wheels rattling downhill faster and faster with no brake, a savage blast of cannon fire mid-descent, then a crash of tumbling iron
B1-26.def: a hasty iron plate takes the strike: a shrieking scrape of metal, a sharp bent clang, wheels skipping and wobbling on loose rock

B1-27.ko: 시험 폭약 펑 · 그을린 작업복에 퍽
B1-27.atk: a workbench tap of tools, a fizzing glass flask tipped into a mixing bowl, then a bursting flash-bang with a rattle of scattering brass bits
B1-27.def: a smoke-blackened leather smock and goggles: a muffled thump, glass lenses ticking, a pot lid clanging off and rolling in a ring

B1-30.ko: 쇠 포차가 불길 뿜음 · 철판에 부딪혀 징 울림
B1-30.atk: a heavy grinding of iron treads, a rumbling surge, then a roaring gout of flame with a boom of the main gun and metal groaning
B1-30.def: thick riveted iron plates: a loud clang, a low resonant ring-out that rolls down the plating, rivets ticking and embers ticking off

B1-31.ko: 손짓 한 번에 포대 일제 사격 · 군도로 막고 묵직하게 서있음
B1-31.atk: a single sharp leather-glove snap, a pause, then a whole battery fires in one huge rolling thunder with a shaking ground rumble
B1-31.def: it stands firm in medal-laden armour: a deep dense clank, a jingle of heavy medals, boots planted and unmoved with a grounded rumble

B1-32.ko: 검은 화약 포 · 출렁이는 바다 울림에 기울어
B1-32.atk: a gurgling pour of black-tinted powder, a deep boom heavy as a slow tide, then a distant wash of rolling surf under the echo
B1-32.def: a hit lands in a thick dark coat: a deep wet slap, a slow swell of low rumble like far-off water sloshing against iron hull

B1-33.ko: 분화구에서 포효하듯 쾅 · 용암 석벽이 꿈쩍 않음
B1-33.atk: a molten crater rumbling, a bellowing deep boom like a volcano's roar, erupting with a roaring rush of sparks and rock
B1-33.def: a cannon barrel sunk into volcanic rock: a thick unmoving stony thud, a bubbling low gurgle of lava, a ring of heated iron

B1-34.ko: 공성 망치와 대포가 함께 · 방패 대열로 막음
B1-34.atk: a marching beat of a crowd, a ram's heavy rumble, then a crashing slam of timber against masonry with a booming cannon salvo
B1-34.def: a wall of shields locks together: a chorus of heavy clacks, a deep wooden thud, boots grinding as a long line holds against the shove

B1-36.ko: 왕관 도화선 불붙여 박치기 폭발 · 쇠 왕관이 울림
B1-36.atk: a fuse fizzing atop an iron crown, a heavy lunge, a head-butt crack and a huge booming detonation with a scatter of coins
B1-36.def: a stout iron crown and fat belly: a deep metallic bong ringing from the crown, jingling coins, and a big fleshy thump with a rolling reverb

B1-41.ko: 낮게 엎드려 총 한 발 · 모래주머니가 푹 삼킴
B1-41.atk: a lazy flip of a hatch, a patient dry rifle crack from behind a low mound, then a sandy puff and faint distant whine
B1-41.def: fat stacked sandbags swallow the hit: a heavy soft whump, a trickle of sand pouring out of a ripped seam, burlap stretching with a creak

B1-42.ko: 쇠옷으로 몸통 박치기 · 쾅 하고 먼지만 털어냄
B1-42.atk: a heavy stomp forward in thick plates, an armoured shoulder shove with a clanking crash, then a few bristling spikes scraping
B1-42.def: the thick suit absorbs a blast: a deep boom muffled by iron, a long ringing clang, loose dust falling, then a spiky metal counter-scrape snapping back

B1-43.ko: 보루 포문이 철컥, 쾅 · 두꺼운 철벽이 울림
B1-43.atk: iron gun-ports clank open with big hinge groans, a thunderous slow boom through a stone loophole, then sparks scraping on masonry
B1-43.def: a mighty iron bulwark: a monstrous deep clang, a long resonant ring-out vibrating the whole wall, then a thorny scrape of spikes in return

SP-B1.ko: 불 삼킨 거인이 숨결로 일제 사격 · 불덩이 몸이 흡수
SP-B1.atk: a huge roaring inhale, a pulsing rumble in a hollow chest, then a volley of fire bursts out with a series of booming blasts and spreading flame
SP-B1.def: a body of living fire absorbs the blow: a hissing flare, a deep rolling heat-roar, sparks swirling inward as the strike dissolves into embers

UN-B1.ko: 일제 사격 · 갑옷으로 받고 도화선 지글
UN-B1.atk: an old brass spyglass snapped shut, a gruff gunfire salvo, a rattling reload clatter, then the hiss of a slow fuse being lit
UN-B1.def: veteran plate and sabre block hard: a sturdy clang, a ringing parry, then a slow sizzling fuse crackling under the fallen heap

UN-B1-7.ko: 불씨 박힌 포탄 쏨 · 불씨가 번져 지직
UN-B1-7.atk: a glowing shell loaded with a dull pulse, a low thump of the shot, a streak whistle, then a spreading crackling of clinging embers
UN-B1-7.def: its thick smouldering coat swallows the blow: a deep thud, a soft shower of falling sparks, embers spitting hotly and spreading across its sleeves

EP-B1-1.ko: 수류탄 연달아 던짐 · 탄띠 두르고 쾅
EP-B1-1.atk: a rapid swish of arms, a rapid chain of bombs lobbed, then a staggered volley of fizzing pops, sharp booms and brass fragments skittering
EP-B1-1.def: a bandolier of grenades and iron breastplate: a deep clank, a jangle of metal pins, a dull rolling crash like a sack of bombs

EP-B1-2.ko: 멀리 총 한 발, 심지 끊김 · 몸을 숨겨 소리 없이
EP-B1-2.atk: a held breath, a razor-sharp rifle crack from afar, a long thin whine across the valley, then a tiny snap of a severed fuse
EP-B1-2.def: it is already gone: a rustle of cloak, a gravel skitter, a quiet empty pebble drop, then a fading far-off echo with nothing struck

EP-B1-3.ko: 거대한 대포 관통탄 · 두꺼운 주철 포신이 울림
EP-B1-3.atk: a monstrous cast-iron gun is rammed and aimed with chain winches, an earth-shattering boom, then a piercing shriek of the shot ripping through everything
EP-B1-3.def: a colossal cast-iron barrel rings: a mighty deep gong, thick rattling chain tension, a slow settling groan of massive metal

PN-B1-C1.ko: 빠르게 장전해 발사 · 단단히 버티고 선 자세
PN-B1-C1.atk: a rapid flurry of ramrod and powder pours, a quick-fire sharp musket crack, then brass casings clinking in a tidy rhythm
PN-B1-C1.def: feet braced, the musket held across: a firm wooden knock, a boot scrape and firm stance, the powder horn clinking only slightly

PN-B1-C3.ko: 쇠 방벽 뒤에서 포 · 철판이 징 울림
PN-B1-C3.atk: a rolling barrier planted with a clang, a gunport flap rattles open, a strong boom and a rumble across the plating
PN-B1-C3.def: a portable iron screen takes the strike: a loud dense clang with a ringing sustain, solid braced feet, no give and only a tiny rivet tick

PN-B1-U1.ko: 열쇠 꾸러미 흔들고 멀리서 한 발 · 단단히 버팀
PN-B1-U1.atk: a heavy ring of iron keys jangles, a bolt thrown, then a long-barrel pistol cracks sharply with a calm pop of smoke
PN-B1-U1.def: a thick coat and brass-buckled belt: a firm leathery thud, keys jingling once, boots staying planted without a stagger

PN-B1-U2.atk: a glowing-red barrel sizzles when lowered, a boom with a lava-hot whoosh, then a sizzling crackle as the barrel cools
PN-B1-U2.def: its heated skin hisses against the strike: a sizzling steam-like hiss, a soft thud, cloth bandages smoking and steam puffing

PN-B1-R.ko: 연기 속 한 발 · 연기 속에 낮게 숨음
PN-B1-R.atk: a deep breath, a drifting whoosh of thick smoke, a single flat sharp crack out of the haze, then a lingering distant ring
PN-B1-R.def: low in the haze, it takes the hit calmly: a muffled thump, a drift of smoke swirling apart, a solid settle of its stance

PN-B1-E.ko: 맥박 박자 맞춰 연발 포 · 땅 울림에 몸이 버팀
PN-B1-E.atk: a deep thumping heartbeat from the ground, quickening, then a rapid sharp pulse of cannon booms with a razor-sharp crack on the last
PN-B1-E.def: firmly planted on a pulsing ground: a heavy iron clang, a slow deep throb, the pulse shaking dust off but not shifting it

UP-B1-12.ko: 큰 폭약 묻어 큰 폭발 · 두꺼운 방호복에 퍽
UP-B1-12.atk: a heavy crate dragged and dropped, a long hiss of a thick fuse, then a deep ground-shaking blast with a long shower of stone
UP-B1-12.def: a reinforced blast-vest and iron helm: a heavy muffled thump, a dull clang of the helm, a sprinkling of pebbles and a low ringing tone

UP-B1-17.ko: 대포 셋이 한꺼번에 쾅쾅쾅 · 포신 셋 뒤에 숨어 묵직
UP-B1-17.atk: three cannons fire in an overlapping boom, one after another, a trio of rolling echoes, with a final heavy crack as chains clank
UP-B1-17.def: behind a trio of thick barrels: a layered metallic bong, three overlapping deep rings, a heavy settling clunk of wood and iron

UP-B1-18.atk: a hardened wall of boots marching forward, a tight blast of musket fire, then a heavy slam of an iron barrel shoved ahead
UP-B1-18.def: iron-banded barrels hardened by blows: each knock rings deeper, a stack of low wooden-and-iron thuds growing firmer, dust falling

UP-B1-24.ko: 정밀 박격탄 높이 · 철모 쓰고 침착
UP-B1-24.atk: a precise brass quadrant click, a smooth drop of a shell down a tube, a high long arcing whistle, then a distant pinpoint thunderclap
UP-B1-24.def: a tilted iron pot-helm: a light bright clang, a calm ring-out, sand slipping softly off its brim and settling in a hush

MB-01.cast: a squat cannon is rammed and fired: ramrod scrape, a deep coughing boom, then a spreading hail of iron balls rattling and ricocheting across stone

MB-04.cast: a match scratches, a long sputtering fizz crawls along a cord, a breathless pause of silence, then a single sharp bang with cinders falling

MC-02.cast: a bayonet drawn across a whetstone: rhythmic rasping scrapes growing faster, then a bright steel ring and a rising shimmer of readiness

SB1-01.cast: a clay ball pops with a soft thud, a long billowing hiss of smoke spreading outward, a muffled rustle of cloth, a sinking dull hush

MB-05.cast: a mortar lobs with a hollow thoomp, a falling whistle, a ground thud and a splitting burst, scattering in a wide crackling spray of fire

SB1-03.cast: a quick scoop of sand and canvas bags thumping up, rifles resting on timber, a clustered snap of shots, then a settling creak of a firm wall

SB1-05.cast: a barked drumbeat of rifle clicks locking, two heavy guns firing in tight succession, hammering twin sharp impacts with a clatter of brass casings

SB1-06.cast: a stone shutter slides with a grating rumble, a hidden cannon barks with a deep boom, then a distant crunching strike falls and echoes

MC-16.cast: a mad scramble of powder poured by handfuls, a ragged thunderous mass of guns firing, with two heavier crashing slams over the roar

SB1-08.cast: a creaking powder store door, a rising crackle of a lit fuse, then a monstrous blinding explosion, rolling shockwave and long falling debris

SB1-09.cast: a whole line of cannons rammed in unison with a chorus of scrapes, then a titanic simultaneous boom, ground rumbling and a rolling echo

RB1-1.cast: a wooden crate smashed open, powder poured in a hissing rush, then a thunderous all-out blast, shaking and long, ending in falling cinders

NB1-1.cast: a heavy shell clunks home, a flat blast, a shrieking whistle, a crashing metal punch through a shield, then a long rolling thud

NB1-3.cast: three hollow thoomps in a row, long arcing falling whistles overlapping, then three muffled crunching thuds landing deep in packed earth

HB1-1.cast: soft creeping footfalls, a lock picked with tiny clicks, a crate lid creaking open, a single fizz, then a muffled boom with scattering paper

US-B1-1.cast: a sharp cannon crack, a shattering hit, a beat of silence, then a second chain-reaction boom that rolls outward in a sequence of blasts

US-B1-2.cast: a glowing shell lobbed with a deep roar, a first blast, then a second echoing hollow blast with a rushing flame roar and sparks

PS-B1-1.cast: a gun hammer clicks, a stuttering spark fizz, then a muffled flash that bursts back with a sharp bang, a rattle of broken fittings

PS-B1-2.cast: a match scratched, a fuse lit with a rising hot hiss, a swelling crackle of fire rising stubbornly, and a deep resolved thump of boots

RS-B1-1.cast: an immense cannon thunder, a rolling spreading fire roar over the ground, crackling and popping, a heavier blast hitting the front

RS-B1-2.cast: a faint pebble shift, a soft step, a click of a pressure plate, then a ground-shaking bang with dirt and gravel rain

RS-B1-3.cast: a hollow shell burst releasing a hail of tiny glowing sparks, whistling streaks swirling and converging, one bigger concentrated hit

CS-B1.cast: a snapping of a spring trap sprung by flame, a torch tossed with a whoosh, a fizzing hiss, then a loud bang with splintering wood

IB1-1.equip: a battered musket is flipped and gripped by the barrel: the wooden stock knocks a belt buckle, a brass butt-plate clinks, one short test swing whooshes

IB1-2.ko: 탄띠를 두르고 심지 한 번 지짐
IB1-2.equip: a leather bandolier is slung and buckled: little powder tubes click together, a flint sparks, a short fuse fizzes briefly and is pinched out

IB1-3.equip: a flared-muzzle blunderbuss is hefted: a hand-cranked lock clicks, a scoop of shot rattles down the bell mouth, a wad is tamped with a thud

IB1-4.equip: a brass spyglass slides out in smooth telescoping clicks, a glass lens is wiped with a squeak, then a tiny focus ring turns and locks with a crisp tick

IB1-5.equip: a short portable cannon is hefted onto the shoulder with iron clanks, a glowing ember is dropped inside with a hot hiss and a rising crackle

IR-B1.equip: a polished musket is lifted, a carved stock notches under the thumb, a smooth lock cocks with a precise double click, a silent steady breath

PI-B1.equip: a glowing ember is lifted from an iron coffer with a low heartbeat thrum, a hot crackle and a rising roar as it nestles into the weapon

TK-U-BOMB.ko: 불붙은 통이 쾅 · 통이 둔하게 튕김
TK-U-BOMB.atk: a rolling wooden keg lurches forward with a hollow thump, its fuse sputtering faster, then a bursting detonation of splintering staves and fire
TK-U-BOMB.def: it bounces and wobbles when hit: a dull hollow wooden knock, staves creaking, the fuse spitting angrily but still burning
